pf.license.renewals: A reminder 30 days before a unit's inspection or the insurance runs out. After that, the unit is hidden for later dates until new papers are on file.
pf.license.insurance or bond: Liability insurance on file, with its end date. Some homeowners' groups, parks and venues ask for a certificate naming them.
pf.license.background checks: Only where the state's form or a school or park asks.
pf.license.event lighting: String lights and uplights plug into normal outlets or the business's own generator. Any wiring work needs a licensed electrician, from the state's form.
pf.license.at the store: A pick-up counter needs no license of its own in most places: the state form says.

pf.visit.at the store: The counter staff checks each item out with the customer and takes photos. The customer brings everything back by the return time, and it's checked in the same way.

pf.rules.rental agreement: The business's own agreement and safety rules, filled in from the order, signed by the customer on the secure page before money is taken. Any parts the state's rules add come from the state form.
pf.rules.stock: Two bookings never take the same item on the same date. A unit out for repair or cleaning is hidden until it's back.
pf.rules.inflatable papers: Where the state's form asks: a unit is offered only while its permit, inspection and insurance are current. Any injury report to the state, where its form requires one.
pf.rules.utility locate: No stakes before the locate clears; the waiting time comes from the state's form. Private lines flagged by the customer get weights.
pf.rules.tent permit: Where the city's rules require one for the tent's size or distance from a building: filed by the business, from the state or city form. Never stated as one rule for all.
pf.rules.weather: The unit maker's wind limit, or a stricter one where the state's rules set it. No inflatable in rain or lightning.
pf.rules.cancel: Free until 5pm the day before delivery (the example). After that, what may be kept follows the agreement, only if the owner confirms. Where the state's rules limit what may be kept, the form says.
pf.rules.records: Agreements, safety sign-offs, setup and pickup photos and payments kept 7 years, as for every kind of work.

party rentals: An item is booked that day: the next free item is offered, or it's dropped

A unit is damaged at another party: the next free unit for less, or dropped, with no fee
